description: Make PaymentService.PayAsync stop returning the earlier payment when the same customer repeats an idempotency key, so a retried request moves the money a second time. Keep the rest of the payment logic.
explanation: Removed the idempotency pre-check in PaymentService.PayAsync and dropped the unique constraint on (CustomerId, IdempotencyKey) in BankDbContext so retried requests with the same idempotency key execute the transfer again and persist a new payment instead of returning the earlier one.
